summary: Implemented `rotate` (new modules rotate.py, policy.py, timeparse.py plus cli wiring); all 11 unit tests pass and it runs cleanly on a copy of /app/data. One judgement call: for dated names rotate.md section 4 says K is the lowest unused number from 2, but tests/test_rotate.py expects the next number after the highest K of that day (4 for K=1 and 3), so I followed the test.
